origin.summary: Workout 5 of the 2019 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A five-step descending thruster-and-chest-to-bar-pull-up ladder starting at 33 reps — a higher-volume relative of Fran's scheme.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2019/5 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
